reviews.text:
This is by far the worst vet clinic and experience I’ve had in my life.

Do not go here for anything other than a routine check up. My senior dog was diagnosed with Osteosarcoma and the vet called me during the middle of the work day to deliver that news. Insensitive, disruptive, and wasn’t even confident on the course of medicine to follow.

The individuals at the front are incompetent. They lack clear communication, have an inability to problem solve and are, quite frankly, rude.
Not once, but twice I have had to have multiple calls (border line arguments) with the staff there just to obtain pain medication for my dog near the end of his life. They have failed to return my calls, they have made it difficult to obtain scripts for the medication, and the lack of professionalism is truly unparalleled.

I could write a review everyday for how terrible this establishment and the individuals who work there are and it wouldn’t be enough. DO NOT GO HERE.
Thank you, Mona, for taking the time to leave a review! Your feedback is appreciated, and we’re here to help if you have any questions or need assistance in the future!
Went in with an emergency bloat issue and Kami and her staff handled surgery quickly and professionally. 100% recommend.
Very curtious friendly and caring I will recommend CityVet to my friends and family
Took my furbaby cause of hotspots and they did an awesome  job with  her,on the way  home I could see her relief!!!

We were traveling from Dallas to San Antonio for a concert. We got an AirBNB so we could take our boy Bruno with us, we had our kids and my mom. Everything was great! Until my boys’ face swelled up and his breathing started sounding like a sharp wheeze/snore. We were up all night with him, then called a few vets and they all said “they were too booked” to see us. It was scary not being in our hometown, looking for emergency vet care.

One of the CityVet’s we called said they couldn’t see us but for us to try the Alamo Heights location. I’m so glad we did!!!  The staff took in Bruno immediately, they showed so much care and concern for Bruno, as well as for me and my husband. We were so scared and emotional. We had lost a previous bulldog to airway issues, so we were terrified.

They kept our boy, even texted us a picture of him through out the day. Dr Jones called us with updated and then again for discharge care for when we went to go pick him up!!

We will forever be grateful for the love and care we received from Alamo Heights!!! We all got back home safely.
Great doctors and techs. Always upfront about animals needs and how to treat and very convenient hours.

City Vet did an incomplete surgery on my cat resulting in needing a second corrective surgery. At the post-op check back vet tech Christie claimed everything was fine and headed well, although his bone is clearly sticking out where his paw pad once was. At the second visit about the bone, vet tech Stacy was very rude causing me to pick my cat up early out of fear for him. The service manager ¿Angela? didn't take responsibility for the repeated errors by several staff members, instead sent me a quote for $700. Come to find out that even though I had originally scheduled the surgery with Dr. Williams because he is apparently a podiatry specialist, Dr Maffrey did the surgery. I'm assuming that is why it wasn't done correctly. I'm stuck with the fact that I left my baby in their care and they injured him. They have caused nothing but pain and suffering to my poor baby, with a pretty hefty price tag at that. After getting the surgery re done at another clinic I attempted to get my kitties medical records from city vet and was denied. How a vet can deny releasing client information to the client speaks volumes about what they're trying to hide.

This was the first time for me and my babies going. The receptionist was very helpful, kind, respectful, understanding and friendly from start to finish. From the first call until I left. During my waiting time my sugar dropped and she gave me some snacks. Thank you it really helped me. The place is super clean. The doctor was knowledgeable, helpful, kind, respectful, understanding, friendly and explained everything to me. My baby was very well taken care of. I already told my friends about this place if they need to take their pets.
Terribly rude receptionist. Apparently their abdominal X-ray pricing “depends based on the condition of the pet.” Not sure how this is possible given its one time imaging.
Thank you, Ernest, for taking the time to leave a review. We appreciate your support!
Thank you, Rosa, for taking the time to leave a review. We appreciate your support!
Thank you, Zainab, for taking the time to leave a review. We appreciate your feedback!
Thank you, Tanner, for taking the time to leave a review! We appreciate your support.

I cannot emphasize enough how wonderful the CityVet staff is. I have been taking my dog here for a couple years now and we have consistently been met with kindness and efficiency. The staff works hard to make sure you feel taken care of and that you get the answers you need. I’ve worked with a few of the vets and several of the vet techs and I adore all of them! Highly recommend City Vet Alamo Heights!!!
Absolutely loved them!
Staff very polite.courteous. and professional. Did great job in relaxing our anxiety

I honestly wish there was an option for a negative star. RUN, do not WALK away from this facility. Egregiously costly, slow as molasses going uphill in January, unhelpful with clinical diagnosis and guidance for a pet facing heart failure. Charged twice for labs because their equipment for reading blood cultures was subpar. The place appeared dirty and smelled awful. Need anything else?
Thank you, Zach, for taking the time to leave a review. We appreciate your support!

Fabulous!!! Comforting
Professional vet care . I am so grateful
Ran all the test on my dog
Sent us home with medications and cans of  Hills diet prescription food. Max is not well, but  hopefully a follow up will help. Thank you JOSEPH  for answering my call and helping me arrive 🙌🙌🙌

Everyone was kind and sympathetic to stress about my fur baby. They did everything to make me feel better without promising anything. The price was laid out and reasonable. Thank you all for helping my little Oliver. ❤️

I would have given 5 stars as the team was thorough and gentle with my overweight best friend. But there were times where I got that look that basically said “your dog is overweight and it’s your fault” and proceeded to successfully make me feel incapable—without knowing her background. I think the overall sentiment should be that we all love our animals and only want the best for them. Other than that I was a great experience.

My husband  and I are so grateful for this comprehensive explanation of Jake's treatment plan, and also for the superb care he has received at City-Vet.
This Is the 2nd time we have brought him to this facility. We want him to continue being a patient here.
The hours, location, and especially the care he has received are far superior to anything we have experienced since we moved to San Antonio.
Thanks.
Dr. Jones is the best!  Wouldn’t take our beloved Toothpick to anyone else.

I've had vet offices that made me feel like I was a talking wallet instead of a pet owner with concerns worth listening to. This is not one of those places! I left my last vet office for the previously stated problems, so switching to CityVet AH and being given such good services by a genuinely caring team was a breath of fresh air!

The payment system is flexible, which is very nice, especially if you have pet insurance. The receptionists (who are all so lovely) have always been timely in sending me everything I need for my claims.

The vets are considerate and good at explaining their findings in an easily digestible way, and their techs are personable and super capable. They were very good at administering care to my ENORMOUS cat who hates being handled.

There is a mutual respect: The doc respects your wishes and doesn't push when you decline something for the moment, and you respect the doc's expertise if they something needs to be done. It's about putting the animal above all else, and I've always felt on the same page with the docs about that, period. I never feel pushed into making an unnecessarily expensive decision, unlike my old place.

Important to know: Your appointment time is serious to the staff, but they are an URGENT CARE CLINIC as well!! If an animal comes in for a dire emergency before yours can be seen, obviously they're going to save that animal first!!! The delay because of an event like this has never been too long in my experience! Seriously, no more than 20-30 minutes. The staff are really on top of things here.
These vets  ñ and vet techs are wonderful.

Thank you to cityvet and Dr. D’Intino for their care and compassion. My fur baby Fellina was having a bad reaction after her vaccines. I was truly distraught going in there with no idea what to expect. The vet tech and Dr. D’Intino constantly reassured me that I made the right call and to not beat myself up over the circumstances. In such a vulnerable moment and in tears, the tech listened to me and extended so much kindness. They even called to get me several quotes to refer me to an emergency vet. 24 hrs later, my fur baby is recovered and doing so well. I am so thankful I went here for their expertise and care, especially in such a sensitive situation. I don’t know what would’ve happened without them!  I won’t forget the kindness extended to me by the Dr and the sweet vet tech. These are truly caring, passionate people.

Dr. Tomaselli and the staff were so kind. I brought my kitty here without an appointment for a hurt foot, and the staff were all so professional and kind. We were able to be seen right away, and Dr. Tomaselli explained everything to me and was very patient, he answered all my questions and made me feel so comfortable. Highly recommend the city vet in AH!

My cat got into some medication. I was able to get him in and be seen by the staff. All of whom were very knowledgeable and happy to assist me as well as the doctor keeping me in the know of what was going on and my options. I am extremely grateful to the staff and treatment of my cat.
Thank you, Jose, for taking the time to leave a review. Your feedback is appreciated, and look forward to seeing you again at CityVet Alamo Heights.
Very professional, very friendly staff. My dog is super hyper and kinda crazy and she loves it, theyre so sweet to my dog and they took very good care of her when she got sick
Hi Gabriela and thank you for your feedback. We appreciate you taking the time to leave a review and hope to hear more from you in the future.
Hi Cynthia, we appreciate your feedback. If you have any specific concerns or thoughts to share, please feel free to reach out, and we would be happy to assist you.

Hi, I'm new to the area. But I'm not so new at owning dogs. 8 years ago I decided not to get my dog spade, and today that decision is haunting me.

I just moved all the way from Wisconsin, and before that Arizona, and I'm not really sure if I ever got my footing.

That's why this morning, when my Juice (my dog) went limp, I knew my options where scares financially. I almost accepted that I would just have to put her down.

These people are my heros. They treated us with kindness, dignity, and respect. And in spite of my circumstances financially, they didn't tell me once to give up on her. Instead they put a plan together for me and whether Juice makes a recovery or not, my conscience doesn't have to battle with the idea that I didn't get her the help she needed.

If any of you read this thank you again from the bottom of my heart from our little family, it meant the world to us.

Juice is below, she's not comfortable at all, but at least she's able to make noise and soon I hope she'll find her strength.

Spay/neuter your dogs early, it can bite you both when you least expect it and go to City Vet, they'll do right by you.
Unfortunately we were recommended because our beautiful Boston terrier passed on,but they were undoubtedly helpful and understanding

Thank you to everyone who works here! My baby had difficulty breathing at night and I was so worried about her. I took her to her vet but they said they were booked and couldn’t care less. I called other places and everyone said I had to wait in line with no promises of being seen. Finally I found this place! They said they will take her right away. I arrived, the employees were so attentive, so careful and caring! They told me it was allergies and prescribed medication. Then they called in a week to follow up!!!! The vet asked me about my dog, her symptoms, her wellbeing. I’m never going to my previous vet clinic again, I will be only coming here❤️

the staff are nice, however we waited a half hour past our appointment time to be seen. And every “hold on we’ll be right back” was about 15 minutes each time with no check-ins. The building doesn’t have a pet relief area inside. The outside is not very pet friendly as it is all paved with no grass around it. There is no water for the dogs without having to ask for it. Advertised as low-cost but it is no lower than closer to where we live. The vet didn’t spend much time with our pet. Communication is slightly lacking between staff members and also between staff and patients. They did let all of us go back with our dog. And there were four of us. Space was very clean and well maintained.
I love Dr Anna. She knows Jayda and takes great care of her.

I had to put my dog down in late February(he had cancer and was too old for an amputation).I had been mentally preparing myself for the final good bye but was still overwhelmed with grief. when the time came I honestly don't think I could have chosen a better place the staff was absolutely amazing during the whole process and after. During such a hard time they truly showed such professionalism and compassion, from the bottom of my heart I thank every person I came into contact that day, the day I picked up his urn, and everyone who signed the condolence card with his paw and nose print

Do not recommend this place.  Took my dog and they said nothing was wrong, (did not like the vet tech care she was rude) 5 days passed and my dog got worse, took him somewhere else and turns out he had an infection, 5 days later with proper treatment, he's doing much better.  DO NOT RECOMMEND THIS PLACE!

Absolutely loved them! We came in at 8pm on a Saturday night and the provided the wait time. It was exactly the wait time. They treated our bulldog quickly and knew what was going on right away. Provided an email to the vet so I could send photos throughout the week to confirm progress. Super happy with urgent care

My sweet boy had the worst ear infection, he was so down and in so much pain.  I am very thankful for the amazing Veterinarians, techs, and staff who took care of my baby..he made a complete 360 andhe is starting to be himself again. Thank you so much, this dog mom is so relieved.

Everyone was very nice from the moment I walked in. They were helpful, professional, and made the whole process easy. I also really appreciate that they offer several different payment options. Thank you soooo much for helping my kitty redd 🧡❤️
This vet is always helpful in my understating of the details. Great scheduling options. We feel like they have our pets best interest at the core.
Friendly staff. Easy to find location. Very reasonably priced. Would definitely visit again
Amazing staff and Vet! Carol was awesome with my fur baby!
Thank you Dr. Williams for always taking great care of Millie!
Took our cat there nothing was done for him he died six hours later.
Thank you, Marilyn, for taking the time to leave a review. We are happy you had a positive experience with Dr. D'Intino. Your feedback is appreciated!
Super friendly staff, fair pricrs, and barely any wait time. Most important, my puppy got great emergency care!! Very recommended

Great experience with doctor and techs, very kind and professional, my only complaint is that we got there at 6:30 and left at 8:50 so we waited a very long time! But other than that it was a good professional experience
Thank you, Melanie, for taking the time to leave a review! We appreciate your support.
Always friendly and professional level of care from all of the staff and Dr D’Intino for our dog Luna! We’re still so grateful to have found City Vet Alamo Heights.
Better priced than other emergency vets, did what they needed to do, compassionate care, and patient with a wide variety of services

I called a hour before they closed Sunday. I was 30 min away. They said come on in and we can help you out with your Kitty. Thenreceptionist, the tech and the Doctor were all so kind. They took such good care of my kitty who ended up having a burst ear drum. They explained everything and gave me prices along the way. Ill be back for sure for my other cats wellness exam. Highly recommend this place! They were a blessing at 8 pm on a Sunday.
Thank you, Eric, for taking the time to leave a review. We appreciate your feedback and are here to help if you have any questions or need assistance.

The staff is AMAZING!  They take time to explain what they want to do, why they want to do it and how much it will cost before moving forward.  Everyone truly loves my dogs and they are soooo good with them!  I won't go anywhere else!♥️
Everyone is so friendly and the vets do a great job of explaining everything and teaching care!
We had an emergency with our dog and everyone there was great!

Took my 2 year old cat here today because he was throwing up foam and acting abnormally. No appt and had never been here before. The woman at the front desk was very sympathetic and immediately helpful and my cat was taken back for vitals within minutes. She got our information and showed my husband and I to a room. The vet tech and then Dr. Jones were quick, efficient, explained everything clearly, and laid out various treatments and costs. Everyone we dealt with was super friendly and helpful. The office was clean and bright and pleasant and they even offered us cold water/sodas before we went to the room. This was by far the best vet visit I have had in San Antonio and I have been to several. Will 100% come back if needed and would recommend. A+!

I had the worst week of my life with the sudden loss of my cat, Gucci. This staff went above and beyond to guide me through this process and Dr Smith even came in on his day off to check on her for me. These people are genuinely so kind, and they care so deeply for the pets that they care for. I can’t imagine going through this loss with anyone else, and I’m quite fortunate that a friend of mine recommended this vet. Thank you so much to the team, I will be back.

I never have to wait for our annual appointment for my doodle. They are fast, thorough and ALWAYS friendly. From the office staff when I walk in to the doctor and technician. I have a high maintenance large dog and they are so patient with her. Love City Vet AH!
Axel, thank you so much for taking the time to leave us a review! We appreciate the support and look forward to being here for Porkchop's future veterinary needs💙🐾 …
The clinic was short staffed but still stayed professional and kept a positive attitude. They did a wonderful job treating my mom's dog.
Great experience with grooming. She listened to my requests and followed through.
So far this place has been a literal life saver for me and my pittie nyla. Staff is friendly and there very prompt it it comes to takin care of your fur baby!

My cats were accidentally given dog flea pills so I had to immediately find somewhere to rush them to. I called this location and it was later in the night close to their closing hours but they still told me to come in anyways. I can’t thank them enough for all of their help for saving my cats lives and still taking us in after hours and staying late ! All of the girls working that night were so nice and helpful!
Great service and very helpful

This applies only to the weekend vet and vet tech. I raced to the vet on a Saturday because my dog ate cocoa in a cookie and cupcake … I was on the phone with ASPCA who vets have you call first and they charge $110 (worth it). They were in the middle of asking me questions and the vet tech was asking us to approve almost $2000 in charges I asked her to wait but she had my husband sign…she could hear me answering questions. ASPCA advised my dog would be fine and no procesdires were needed. I ran out to tell them and gave the vet tech the phone. It was literally a minute later and the vet tech said the doctor insisted on talking to the ASPCA…I wondered why until I saw that minute call was so she could charge $250 and they had somehow done the blood tests already. The visit was $800 but would have been $300ish but they seemed to not want to wait 30 seconds to let me tell them what the ASPCA had to say. Then they wanted to pile on so much more…my dog never seemed sick and the vet and tech seemed to want to beat ASPCA’s assessment (which they insist you calling). The blood tests that they somehow took so quickly were also NEVER explained.  I asked at checkout about the results and the tech said “oh she’s fine” which is less than a thorough response for $300. I asked whether they would show anything that quickly and she said “yeah probably”. I really like the other vets and techs and never feel like they are just trying to pile on.and avoid hearing what they seemed to already know…that my dog was fine and ASPCA would say she didn’t need blood tests or to speak to them.

I would not recommend this clinic. My wife took our black lab puppy after he hadn’t eaten much for 2 days. They took X-rays and confirmed he had a blockage in his lower intestine. They tried to pressure us into a nearly $4500 surgery, claiming no other option. Luckily we reached out for a second opinion. Our primary vet looked at the X-rays and based on his condition at the time, felt we had enough time for less invasive options. We removed him from this location after they wouldn’t help us further and he was stabilized and treated at our primary. He passed the object without surgery a day later. Thank goodness for vets that are willing to use their brain to solve an issue, and not so willing to cut an animal open for a quick fix and/or hefty price tag. This practice is NOT that. (Our primary quoted us for surgery in worst case scenario and it was half the price).
Very happy 😊
I didn't know vets were this expensive, all I got was two shots and some deworming and I'm out 544$💀
Great group of Vets.  Always trying to be accommodating while taking care of our pets!
Hi Victor, thank you for taking the time to leave us a review! Your support means a lot to us.
Great customer service. Listened to my concerns and gave me several options. Also very nice to my pup!
It was good they are always nice and helpful!
Staff was courteous and explained treatment options available to me.

01.01.2026: Check out lady REFUSED to give me my receipt. That is unacceptable! Will be contacting corporate, if any.

Ruby was attacked at a local dog park this morning, New years day. Needed stitches for a hole in her ear.

Never had to come to doggie ER. Vet visits, sure. Not this. Never expected THIS!

Well, I was in a frozen, ugly cry, panic.. bc of course, OF COURSE, this would happen on NEW YEARS DAY. Everything is closed.

Well these kind folks love critters enough to have come to work today to make sure us pet parents can get the help we need.

Everyone was amazing. Front desk. Triage nurse. Doctor Mallory.

Everything was clean. I was there several hours. I'm sure double, probably triple the normal waiting time.

That's ok. They had someone call in due to illness and I'm sure everyone else is off for holiday.

I didn't mind. I had her backpack, food, toys, blanket, we were ok.

She's still in surgery, I'll be picking her up shortly.

*Surgery went well, took awhile for her to wake up and come together. Doctor explained things better than any human doctor. Very at ease, a people person, reassuring and so, so, kind. Doctor was an absolute gem! So thankful my dog was in good hands. The team that did her sutures was so incredibly gentle and patient with her. She didn't like the first attempt at the sedative shot and cried. They talked her through it and she was just fine.

Will update again after all is healed in two weeks.

Last front desk girl REFUSED to give me an invoice before leaving. How does my dog's care, surgery, at that!, not warranty a receipt for a medical procedure!! UNACCEPTABLE.

THAT IS ILLEGAL. WILL BE CONTACTING CORPORATE OFFICE.

01.24.2026: Did NOT return. Had her vet remove the stitches and drain her ear. She's got a continuous fluid filled ear pocket on both sides due the type of stitching. Apparently it should have been a quilt stitch to avoid this refilling of fluid in her ear.
3 weeks now of this fluid draining.

He said that some dogs take up to 10 weeks to heal from complications exactly like this.
So we drain weekly and he monitors.

Suzy was amazing! She explained everything well, she was friendly, and super sweet with my cat Buttercup. Dr. Jones was thorough with examining Buttercup and super gentle with her. I would definitely return and recommended  CitiVet to friends and family.

My poor orange boy was showing symptoms of a UTI last night, City Vet Alamo Heights got me in right away the next morning after I was having issues with the website.

Staff was all amazing! Friendly and helpful from start to finish, they kept me updated on pricing throughout our visit and were thorough every step of the way. I’m happy to have a clinic nearby that I know I can trust in the event my pets are in need. Thank you all so much!
Staff is very sweet and welcoming. They were understanding of my shy/anxious cat especially with today being our first time at city vet. Overall,  had a quick and easy visit. Would recommend.

I took my dog in for a last minute urgent care appointment. The staff was helpful and friendly. The time we waited to see the doctor was quicker than expected. They also texted me the next day to make sure my dog was recovering well. Overall would recommend!
Thank you for your 5-star review!
Excellent service, short wait times, clear and affordable pricing. Very thankful to receive quality care here on Broadway.
City Vet Alamo Heights is amazing! The care and personalized support they have provide to my fur baby has been wonderful.
The staff is always so incredibly kind. This is the only vet in which my dog actually wants to visit.
Fantastic staff and veterinary care. Top notch!!!
all three of the women there were very kind and helpful in a very scary situation. Couldn’t recommend more. My kittie kiwi thanks y’all!
The staff is very caring. Dr. Gilsen has always been a great care provider with our Lily. We are grateful to have such great professionals and staff at CityVet!
Dr Bunning is amazing!!!

We had the best experience with Dr D’Intino and the veterinary  technician . She was incredible and made our puppy feel very special . They both took a lot of time with us to answer questions and to make us feel special . I highly recommend.
Very thorough and shared details with me about my dogs visit

The vet was kind enough to take in my cat shortly before closing instead of sending me to the ER, and they took care of him, saving his life. The vet and vet tech were exceptionally kind and caring. You can tell they really care about the animals there.

Typical corporation run vet that tries to upsell you the second you walk in. I went in for a routine librella shot I normally do with city vet south town, no one told me before I got there that the vet would need to do an exam and bloodwork. I explained the she got one done two months ago, extensive bloodwork and urine analysis and was medically cleared. I let them know I could have that vet send the information over. They kept saying no I didn’t have to do that and that they still would need to do their own cbc and exam. She’s been off librela 4 months bc I tried to see if she truly needed it and sure enough she slowed down again.  But restarting after 4 month break doesn’t require bloodwork. In fact starting librela doesn’t require bloodwork at all, and at 13 years old librela is considered a standard of medical care for the dog.

Right when I came in they asked me urgently how is she doing with poop, pee, vomit and didn’t seem satisfied when I said she was fine.

Completely shady, vet wouldn’t even talk to me herself she kept sending out her tech to tell me what more is required that I pay. She had extensive bloodwork two months ago they weren’t even interested in looking at!!

Wasted my time and my poor senior dog gets nervous at the vet so we went for nothing. I wouldn’t let them upsell me.

Had to bring my pup in an hour before they closed on Christmas Eve. They were able to fit him in and treated both of us so kindly.  Didn't rush us at all and even brought him a lil pup cup! Amazing service- thank you!
Rebecca, thank you so much for taking the time to leave us a review! We appreciate you so much! Thank you for trusting us with the care of Apollo.
Yen, thank you so much for taking the time to leave us a review! We appreciate you so much! Thank you for trusting us with the care of your fur babies.
Just called on a Sunday! Karen was so kind and informative. Step by step instructions, compassionate and so so kind. Thinks you guys were all you do!!!!

Absolutely the Kindest, Loving Caring office we have ever been to!!! Dr. Amanda Williams and staff are above and beyond amazing! Extremely thorough in the exam room and out . Our Coco is now on her way to feeling better thanks to this clinic

CityVet Alamo Heights is a home away from home for our fur baby, Beren, Havanese. Grooming, Boarding, Urgent Care, and excellent Vet Services are their superpowers! They treat your pet like royalty with much love and grace.

Called the store with some questions first and the very kind receptionist walked me through the steps perfectly. Decided to take my Kitty in as an emergency visit because I just knew something was up, and she was getting taken care of wonderfully despite being a tougher patient. I was explained all my options thoroughly and the steps we needed to take to get her back to normal. They cleaned up my girl for me and sent me home with some medicine to help her. They were kind, patient, and the place was very clean. Awesome experience guys, thank you!
Friendliest staff loving and caring!
Nicole, thank you so much for taking the time to leave us a review! We appreciate you so much! Thank you for trusting us with the care of your fur babies.

I couldn’t ask for a better place to take Clover than City Vet. Her Veterinarian is there, along with a team of highly qualified staff and it just so happens to be an ER Vet as well. She has playtime every few hours. Walks twice a day. I get updates and photos from one of their staff members at least every other day.

We’re so blessed to have city vet, you really couldn’t ask for more! If you’re contemplating taking your pet anywhere else look no further. You know that you’re sending your animal/animals to the right place when they’re excited to get there. I’m going to share a few, well quite a few photos of Clover when she’s there to give you your pets city vet experience. Thanks again City Vet, y’all are a godsend and we don’t know what we’d do without you! See you next time.
Sincerely,
Camille Malek

I am so glad I decided to come here for my dogs care, i found them on the internet and they were the closet to me. I am very thankful for Dr. Nicole D’Intino and her whole team. Everyone from the start of walking in, the front desk acknowledged us right away. Everyone was professional and super sweet. Dr. D’Intino took time to explain everything to us and give us updates. Me and my husband felt well taken care of and I knew my dog Cooper was in the right hands. Thank you so much everyone here at CityVey, yall are amazing and I highly recommend your care!
Your staff was very helpful and courteous. They tended to Cojo with the odmost care. The doktor explained the process so we understood what our pet was going to go through. Thank you very much.
This place is so awesome, the lady at the front desk was real helpful and awesome, I thank everyone there for helping me with my Mother's pet dog,great job
What a wonderful group of the kindest most professional awesome people!! I won't ever go anywhere else!! Thank you!! 😊

Dr. Gilson is amazing! I recently relocated to San Antonio and finding a good vet for my dog was a top priority. Dr. Gilson was kind, patient, and answered all of my questions. I left her office feeling grateful, heard, and my dog was comfortable the whole visit. She really took her time to get to know both him and me. I highly recommend this clinic.

phenomenal care, literally phenomenal. the staff not only care about your pet but truly make you feel as if theyre being taken care of in the best hands possible. my baby ingested some rat poison and they helped me stay calm and found a treatment plan for him that fit my budget perfectly! 10/10, veterinary care and i truly mean it is 10 out of 10 service!!! i am going to recommend this office, and their team to anyone with a dog/cat that needs a vet from here on out. 10/10.

We've had a great experience with Dr. D'Intino since starting to see her in May of this year. At that time, we had recently found 2 stray kittens with a ton of medical problems and our 13-year old cat decided to become a geriatric medical mystery. Throughout it all, Dr. D'Intino has been a stable source of personable care. She makes sure to thoroughly explain her differentials, how these might be tested/confirmed, and treatment plans.
